facts.text: Kent State's Undergraduate Tuition Guarantee Program guarantees eligible new first-year and transfer students that Ohio resident tuition, career services fees, and room and board charges will not increase for their cohort.

sources.title: Undergraduate Tuition Guarantee Program < Kent State University
sources.quote: All eligible new first-year and transfer undergraduate students are given the certainty that the Ohio resident tuition rate (i.e., instructional and general fee), career services fee and room and board plan charges will not increase for their applicable cohort rate.
